I am a Double Doc (Medicine & Ph.D.) living in Bangalore, India.\
I currently serve as a Medical Scientist at the Regional Occupational Health Centre under the ICMR - National Institute of Occupational Health.\

ICMR (Indian Council of Medical Research) is an apex body for medical research in India.
